collection_note: Workflow logs produced five successful batches (100 run records, 99 unique runs after deduplication) and covered only a partial slice of the 24-hour window. A later logs batch failed on an oversized lifecycle session record; the next request ended with the 60-second context deadline, so collection switched to the GitHub API fallback. The available Actions list API has no created-at filter or field selection, its first page was insufficient for full-window per-workflow conclusions, and issue search results were integrity-filtered while PR search results did not consistently match the workflow-call marker. Safe-output activity, delivery, adoption, tokens, and durations below are observed partial-log values only. Run outcome counts are zero placeholders with coverage unavailable and must not be interpreted as zero activity. Cost in USD and engagement attribution are unavailable. The retained lifecycle snapshot is separately partial, with no discovery checkpoint or deferred count and one lifecycle collection error.
